DRIFT_RECONCILIATION=main first advanced to f925daab6526371af0c0cf8425a4647a02af95c7 support/deploy files, then 179e688e234fd54cedf99aa7792c86de00bba947 landed actual Gen3 Alpha1 app runtime. Revalidation on final head confirms FoldOverlayService still uses latestControlAngle with one pending main delivery; PanelEngine still uses TiltFollower and SAMSUNG_LIVE_TAU_S=0.028f; TiltFollower is unchanged; TransitionLab remains observation-only. Thus the selected limitation survives Gen3, but wiring must target Gen3 ownership. STRONGEST_PROVEN_FINDING=the precise Fold7 visual path still controls displayed fold geometry from the latest delivered hinge angle through a 28ms first-order TiltFollower rather than targeting the hinge position expected at physical frame presentation, despite public FrameTimeline timing and existing observation infrastructure. An Android-free bounded delivery-time predictor compiled and passed 10/10 focused checks. In a 1,260-case synthetic matrix, the conservative 20ms compensation/36ms horizon candidate reduced MODELED mean case angular MAE 5.626deg->2.223deg (60.5%), with 0/1260 worse case-average MAE and 0/1260 worse frame-P95; 3/1260 abrupt 60Hz reversal cases had slightly worse single-frame max, worst +0.428deg. STRONGEST_REMAINING_UNCERTAINTY=physical Z Fold7 visual phase magnitude, real Samsung jitter/timestamp quality, callback/render/present latency, GPU/main-thread effect, perceptual benefit, and optimal constants. INTEGRATION_DEPENDENCY=state-rd hinge-ingress work proved the still-present latest-only bridge can erase semantic samples and supplied an ordered timestamped mailbox proposal.
